read.en: Corning rose 3.9% on Oct 28 to $131.20, trading between $125.41 and $133.24 on 1.4 times average volume. It is above the falling 5-day ($126.6) and 10-day ($130.3) averages and below the falling 30-day ($147.1) and 100-day ($162.3) and the rising 200-day ($155.3). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 12 ($134.47), and RSI is 41.
read.zh: 康宁 10月28日上涨 3.9%，收于 $131.20，盘中区间 $125.41–133.24，成交量为均量的 1.4 倍。股价位于下行的 5 日（$126.6）和 10 日均线（$130.3）上方，低于下行的 30 日（$147.1）和 100 日均线（$162.3）以及上行的 200 日均线（$155.3）。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月12日起看空（$134.47），RSI 为 41。

read.en: The close cleared the $128.5–128.6 cap (Oct 26–27 highs) and the 10-day, now support; the high stalled at $133.2. Resistance is $132.75–133.2 (Oct 15 low, Oct 28 high), then $134.5 (SAR) and $138.65 (Oct 15 high). Support is $128.5–130.3, then $125.4–126.6 (Oct 28 low, 5-day) and $121.8–122.8. A close above $133.2 would target $134.5–138.7; below $128.5, $125.4.
